evidence.notes: Formation is explicit; où follows a time noun such as année, jour, instant, siècle and introduces the clause.
Formation 'se + verb (conjugated)'; the reflexive pronoun precedes the verb, e.g. ça se dit, ça se voit.

patches.entity_key: Passive used to avoid specifying agent
patches.value: subject + être (conjugated) + past participle, with no par + agent phrase

evidence.notes: The passive is used when the agent is unknown, unimportant or deliberately omitted, so the agent slot after par is left empty.

patches.value: receiver of the action as subject + être (conjugated) + past participle (+ par + agent)

evidence.notes: Fronting the receiver of the action into the subject slot is what creates the emphasis; the agent phrase remains optional.

patches.value: subject + être (conjugated in the required tense) + past participle agreeing with the subject

evidence.notes: Formation is explicit; the past participle follows être and agrees with the subject in gender and number.
Formation 'auxiliary (avoir/être) + past participle'; negation wraps the auxiliary as ne + auxiliary + pas + past participle.

patches.entity_key: Past conditional for regret or reproach
patches.value: auxiliary (avoir/être) in conditionnel présent + past participle (+ infinitive after devoir/vouloir/aimer)

evidence.notes: The compound past conditional form carries regret or reproach; expressions such as aurais dû / aurait voulu place an infinitive after the participle.

patches.entity_key: Past conditional for unconfirmed past information (journalistic)
patches.value: subject + auxiliary in conditionnel présent + past participle

evidence.notes: The conditionnel journalistique uses the same auxiliary + participle order as any past conditional to report allegedly true past events.

patches.entity_key: Past conditional with si clause in plus-que-parfait
patches.value: si + plus-que-parfait clause, main clause in past conditional

evidence.notes: Formation is explicit; the past conditional stays in the main clause and never in the si clause.

patches.value: main clause in passé composé + que + dependent verb in conditionnel

evidence.notes: Formation 'Main clause passé composé + dependent verb conditionnel'; a future in direct speech shifts to the conditionnel in the reported clause.
